title: Display two linear SVM boundaries
description: You pass each model's decision function to a training-data plot.

steps.description: You create the left panel and pass sign_pg to the plotting helper. sign_pg returns the Pegasos decision function's values directly.

steps.question: Do these wrappers threshold scores into class labels?
steps.answer: Each wrapper returns its decision function's result unchanged. There is no threshold operation in either wrapper.

steps.description: You create the right panel using the batch model's decision function. Both plot calls receive X_tr and y_tr.
You lay out and display the panels together. Their titles distinguish Pegasos from Batch on the same training data.
